content.text:
An agent harness built in the open, not behind a launch post.

oh-my-openagent is a dev-focused harness for running and shaping coding agents. The interesting bit is the workflow: features, fixes, and triage happen live with an AI assistant on a customized OpenClaw fork. Messy, transparent, useful.

Watch the repo if you care about agent tooling.

#devtools #aiagents #opensource #github #codingagents #openclaw
